202 template<typename A, typename V, typename Conv = const std::nullopt_t&>
203 A _splitdict_to_aggregate(std::map<std::string, V>&& v, bool cut_minus = true, Conv&& conv = std::nullopt)
204 {
205 if (v.size() != reflect::size<A>())
206 throw utility::construct_exception<std::invalid_argument>(std::format("map has {} elements but type {} has {} members", v.size(), reflect::type_name<A>(), reflect::size<A>()));
207
208 if (cut_minus)
209 {
210 std::map<std::string, V> temp_v{};
211 while (!v.empty())
212 {
213 auto&& node = v.extract(v.begin());
214 auto&& key = node.key();
215
216 if (key.starts_with('-'))
217 key = key.substr(1);
218
219 temp_v.insert(temp_v.end(), std::move(node));
220 }
221 v = std::move(temp_v);
222 }
223
224 auto inner_visitor = [&v, &conv]<size_t I>()->reflect::member_type<I, A> {
225 auto key = /*rfl::fields<A>()[I].name()*/reflect::member_name<I, A>();
226 auto&& node = v.extract(std::string(key));
227 if (node.empty())
228 throw utility::construct_exception<std::invalid_argument>(std::format("key '{}' not found", key));
229 auto&& mapped = node.mapped();
230
231 if constexpr (std::same_as<Conv, const std::nullopt_t&>)
232 {
233 if constexpr (hhh::meta::is_template_instance<V, std::variant>)
234 return std::get<reflect::member_type<I, A>>(std::move(mapped));
235 else
236 return std::move(mapped);
237 }
238 else
239 {
240 return conv.template operator()<reflect::member_type<I, A>>(std::move(mapped));
241 }
242 };
243
244 auto visitor = [&inner_visitor]<size_t...I>(std::integer_sequence<size_t, I...>)->A {
245 return A{ inner_visitor.template operator()<I>()... };
246 };
247
248 return visitor(std::make_index_sequence<reflect::size<A>()>{});
249 }

1261 void _unbind(std::vector<std::string>&& what, const std::string& funcid)
1262 {
1263 auto prefix = std::format("if {{\"[{} ", funcid);
1264 std::string keep{};
1265 for(auto&& s : this->tk->call<std::string>(what | std::views::transform(_cpptkinter::AsObj))
1266 | std::views::split('\n')
1267 | std::views::filter([&](const auto& line) { return !std::ranges::starts_with(line, prefix); }))
1268 {
1269 keep.append_range(s);
1270 keep.push_back('\n');
1271 }
1272 if (keep.ends_with('\n'))
1273 keep.pop_back();
1274
1275 auto temp_keep = keep;
1276 temp_keep.erase(0, temp_keep.find_first_not_of("\t\n\v\f\r ")); // left trim
1277 temp_keep.erase(temp_keep.find_last_not_of("\t\n\v\f\r ") + 1); // right trim
1278 if (temp_keep.empty())
1279 keep = "";
1280
1281 this->tk->call(what | std::views::transform(_cpptkinter::AsObj), keep);
1282 this->deletecommand(funcid);
1283 }

1323 template<typename T>
1324 requires (cnfs::is_cnf_member<std::remove_cvref_t<T>> && !hhh::meta::is_template_instance<std::remove_cvref_t<T>, std::optional>)
1325 _cpptkinter::Tcl_Obj _options_inner_visitor(T&& value)
1326 {
1327 auto visitor = [&]<typename T2>(T2 && value) {
1328 if constexpr (detail::createcommand_concept<T2>)
1329 return _cpptkinter::AsObj(this->_register(std::forward<T2>(value)));
1330 else
1331 return _cpptkinter::AsObj(value);
1332 };
1333
1334 return utility::visit_or_invoke(visitor, std::forward<T>(value));
1335 }
1336 protected:
1338 template<cnfs::is_cnf CNF>
1339 std::vector<_cpptkinter::Tcl_Obj> _options(CNF&& cnf, const std::set<std::string>& ignore_fields = {})
1340 {
1341 std::vector<_cpptkinter::Tcl_Obj> raii{};
1342
1343 auto visitor = [&]<typename T>(T&& value, auto I) {
1344 auto k = /*rfl::fields<CNF>()[I].name()*/reflect::member_name<I, CNF>();
1345 if (ignore_fields.contains(std::string(k)))
1346 return;
1347
1348 if (k.ends_with('_'))
1349 /*k.erase(k.size() - 1)*/k.remove_suffix(1);
1350
1351 raii.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-" + std::string(k)));
1352 raii.emplace_back(this->_options_inner_visitor(std::forward<T>(value)));
1353 };
1354
1355 reflect::for_each<CNF>([&](auto I) {
1356 utility::invoke_or_and_then(visitor, reflect::get<I>(std::forward<CNF>(cnf)), I);
1357 });
1358
1359 return raii;
1360 }

1374 template<detail::createcommand_concept Func>
1375 std::string _register(Func&& func, bool needcleanup = true)
1376 {
1377 DEVIATING_IMPLEMENTATION_WARNING("original has subst");
1378
1379 auto f = detail::CallWrapper{ utility::callable_to_std_function(std::forward<Func>(func)), *this };
1380 auto name = (std::ostringstream() << detail::tcl_command_name_counter++ << "_" << &func << "_").str();
1381 if constexpr (requires { std::ostringstream() << func; })
1382 name += (std::ostringstream() << func).str();
1383 else
1384 name += typeid(func).name();
1385
1386 std::ranges::replace_if(name, [](char c) { return detail::tcl_forbidden_chars.contains(c); }, '_');
1387 this->tk->createcommand(name, std::move(f));
1388 if (needcleanup)
1389 this->_tclCommands.insert(name);
1390 return name;
1391 }

1393 static constexpr std::array _subst_format = { "%#"sv, "%b"sv, "%f"sv, "%h"sv, "%k"sv, "%s"sv, "%t"sv, "%w"sv, "%x"sv, "%y"sv, "%A"sv,
1394 "%E"sv, "%K"sv, "%N"sv, "%W"sv, "%T"sv, "%X"sv, "%Y"sv, "%D"sv };
1395 static const inline std::string _subst_format_str = hhh::misc::join_strings(_subst_format, " ");
1397 Event _substitute(MISC_SUBSTITUTE_PARAMETERS)
1398 {
1399 // print args
1400
1401 // [&](auto&...args) { (utility::visit_or_invoke([](auto& a) { std::println("{}", a); }, args), ...); }(MISC_SUBSTITUTE_ARGUMENTS);
1402
1403 static auto get_long_long = [](auto&& p, long long def = std::numeric_limits<long long>::min()) {
1404
1405 auto inner = [&]<typename T>(const T & arg)->long long {
1406 if constexpr (std::same_as<T, std::string>)
1407 {
1408 if (arg == "??")
1409 return def;
1410
1411 try
1412 {
1413 return std::stoll(arg);
1414 }
1415 catch (const std::invalid_argument& e)
1416 {
1417 throw utility::construct_exception<std::runtime_error>(std::format("{} on argument {}", e.what(), arg));
1418 }
1419 }
1420 else
1421 {
1422 return arg;
1423 }
1424 };
1425
1426 return utility::visit_or_invoke(inner, p);
1427 };
1428
1429 static auto get_bool = [&]<typename T>(const T & p) {
1430 auto ll = get_long_long(p, 0);
1431 if (ll == 0)
1432 return false;
1433 else if (ll == 1)
1434 return true;
1435 else
1436 throw utility::construct_exception<std::runtime_error>(std::format("expected 0 or 1 but got {}", ll));
1437 };
1438
1439 auto serial = get_long_long(nsign);
1440 auto num = get_long_long(b);
1441 auto focus = get_bool(f);
1442 auto height = get_long_long(h);
1443 auto width = get_long_long(w);
1444 auto keycode = get_long_long(k);
1445 auto state = get_long_long(s);
1446 auto time = get_long_long(t);
1447 auto x_ = get_long_long(x);
1448 auto y_ = get_long_long(y);
1449 auto x_root = get_long_long(X);
1450 auto y_root = get_long_long(Y);
1451 auto char_ = A;
1452 auto send_event = get_bool(E);
1453 auto keysym = K;
1454 auto keysym_num = get_long_long(N);
1455 auto type = EventType(get_long_long(T));
1456 auto widget = this->nametowidget(W);
1457 auto delta = get_long_long(D, 0);
1458
1459 return {
1460 serial,
1461 num,
1462 focus,
1463 height,
1464 width,
1465 keycode,
1466 state,
1467 time,
1468 x_,
1469 y_,
1470 x_root,
1471 y_root,
1472 char_,
1473 send_event,
1474 keysym,
1475 keysym_num,
1476 type,
1477 widget,
1478 delta
1479 };
1480 }

1484 std::map<std::string, std::array<std::variant<long long, std::string>, 5>> _getconfigure(std::vector<_cpptkinter::Tcl_Obj>&& raii)
1485 {
1486 using V = std::variant<long long, std::string, _cpptkinter::Tcl_Obj>;
1487 using Arr = std::array<V, 5>;
1488
1489 auto vec = this->tk->call<std::vector<Arr>>(std::move(raii));
1490
1491 auto key_view = vec | std::views::transform([&](Arr& e) { return std::get<std::string>(std::move(e.at(0))).substr(1); });
1492
1493 auto v_lambda = []<typename T>(T & e)->std::variant<long long, std::string> {
1494 if constexpr (std::same_as<T, long long> || std::same_as<T, std::string>)
1495 return std::move(e);
1496 else
1497 return e._repr_();
1498 };
1499 auto value_view = vec | std::views::transform([&](Arr& arr) {
1500 std::array<std::variant<long long, std::string>, 5> new_arr{};
1501 std::ranges::move(arr | std::views::transform([&](V& e) { return std::visit(v_lambda, e); }), new_arr.begin());
1502 return new_arr; });
1503
1504 return /*std::views::*/zip(key_view, value_view) | /*std::ranges::*/to<std::map>();
1505 }
1506 std::array<std::variant<long long, std::string>, 5> _getconfigure1(std::vector<_cpptkinter::Tcl_Obj>&& raii)
1507 {
1508 using V = std::variant<long long, std::string, _cpptkinter::Tcl_Obj>;
1509 using Arr = std::array<V, 5>;
1510
1511 auto arr = this->tk->call<Arr>(std::move(raii));
1512 std::array<std::variant<long long, std::string>, 5> new_arr{};
1513
1514 auto v_lambda = []<typename T>(T & e)->std::variant<long long, std::string> {
1515 if constexpr (std::same_as<T, long long> || std::same_as<T, std::string>)
1516 return std::move(e);
1517 else
1518 return e._repr_();
1519 };
1520 std::ranges::move(arr | std::views::transform([&](V& e) { return std::visit(v_lambda, e); }), new_arr.begin());
1521
1522 return new_arr;
1523 }

1970 template<typename R, typename...Args>
1971 struct detail::CallWrapper
1972 {
1973 std::function<R(Args...)> func;
1974 Misc/*utility::weak<Misc>*/ widget;
1975
1977 R operator()(Args...args)
1978 {
1979 try
1980 {
1981 return this->func(std::forward<Args>(args)...);
1982 }
1983 catch (...)
1984 {
1985 this->widget/*.lock()*/._report_exception();
1986 throw;
1987 }
1988 }
1989 };

1992 {
1993 bool _tkloaded = false;
1994
1998 void destroy() override
1999 {
2000 // keeps this from being destroyed before this function returns
2001 auto temp = this->shared_from_this();
2002
2003 for (auto&& child : std::vector(std::from_range, std::views::values(this->children)))
2004 child.destroy();
2005 this->tk->call("destroy", this->_w);
2006 this->Misc::impl::destroy();
2007 if (detail::_support_default_root && detail::_default_root.get() == this)
2008 detail::_default_root.reset();
2009 }
2010 };

2063 void _loadtk()
2064 {
2065 this->_tkloaded = true;
2066
2067 // Version sanity checks
2068 auto tk_version = this->tk->getvar<std::string>("tk_version");
2069 if (tk_version != _cpptkinter::TK_VERSION)
2070 throw utility::construct_exception<std::runtime_error>(std::format("tk.h version {} doesn't match libtk.a version {}", _cpptkinter::TK_VERSION, tk_version));
2071
2072 // Under unknown circumstances, tcl_version gets coerced to float
2073 auto tcl_version = this->tk->getvar<std::string>("tcl_version");
2074 if (tcl_version != _cpptkinter::TCL_VERSION)
2075 throw utility::construct_exception<std::runtime_error>(std::format("tcl.h version {} doesn't match libtcl.a version {}", _cpptkinter::TCL_VERSION, tcl_version));
2076
2077 // Create and register the tkerror and exit commands. We need to parts of _register here, _ register would register differently-named commands.
2078 this->tk->createcommand("tkerror", detail::_tkerror);
2079 this->tk->createcommand("exit", detail::_exit);
2080 this->_tclCommands.insert("tkerror");
2081 this->_tclCommands.insert("exit");
2082 if (detail::_support_default_root && detail::_default_root.get() == nullptr)
2083 detail::_default_root = std::static_pointer_cast<impl>(this->pimpl);
2084 this->protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", std::function<void()>(std::bind_front(&Tk::destroy, *this)));

2110 void readprofile(const std::string& className)
2111 {

2114 auto class_tcl = std::filesystem::path(home) / std::format(".{}.tcl", className);
2115 auto class_py = std::filesystem::path(home) / std::format(".{}.py", className);
2116 auto base_tcl = std::filesystem::path(home) / std::format(".{}.tcl", className);
2117 auto base_py = std::filesystem::path(home) / std::format(".{}.py", className);
2118
2119 if (std::filesystem::is_regular_file(class_tcl))
2120 this->tk->call("source", "\"" + class_tcl.string() + "\"");
2121 //if os.path.isfile(class_py):
2122 // exec(open(class_py).read(), dir)
2123 if (std::filesystem::is_regular_file(base_tcl))
2124 this->tk->call("source", "\"" + base_tcl.string() + "\"");
2125 //if os.path.isfile(base_py) :
2126 // exec(open(base_py).read(), dir)
2127
2128 DEVIATING_IMPLEMENTATION_WARNING("original executes class_py and base_py with python's exec()");
2129 }
2130
2134 std::function<void(Tk&, const std::exception_ptr&)> report_callback_exception = &Tk::default_report_callback_exception;

2152 template<typename T>
2153 concept Variable_mode_concept = std::convertible_to<T, std::string> || (utility::is_vector<T> && std::convertible_to<typename T::value_type, std::string>);
2154
2155 template<typename T>
2156 T pack_grid_info(auto&& self, const std::string& a1, const std::string& a2, const std::string& a3)
2157 {
2158 using V = std::variant<long long, std::string, _cpptkinter::tk_window_type>;
2159 auto map = self.tk->template call<std::map<std::string, V>>(a1, a2, a3);
2160
2161 if (map.size() != reflect::size<T>())
2162 throw utility::construct_exception<std::invalid_argument>(std::format("map has {} elements but type {} has {} members", map.size(), reflect::type_name<T>(), reflect::size<T>()));
2163
2164 auto converter = [&self]<typename T2>(V&& v)->T2
2165 {
2166 if constexpr (std::same_as<T2, Misc>)
2167 return self.nametowidget(std::get<_cpptkinter::tk_window_type>(std::move(v)));
2168 else if constexpr (std::same_as<T2, bool>)
2169 return std::get<long long>(std::move(v));
2170 else
2171 return std::get<T2>(std::move(v));
2172 };
2173 return detail::_splitdict_to_aggregate<T>(std::move(map), true, converter);
2174 }
2175 }

2292 template<detail::createcommand_concept Func>
2293 std::string _register(Func&& callback)
2294 {
2295 auto f = detail::CallWrapper{ std::function(std::forward<Func>(callback)), this->_root };
2296 auto cbname = (std::ostringstream() << detail::tcl_command_name_counter++ << "_" << &callback << "_").str();
2297 if constexpr (requires { std::ostringstream() << callback; })
2298 cbname += (std::ostringstream() << callback).str();
2299 else
2300 cbname += typeid(callback).name();
2301
2302 std::ranges::replace_if(cbname, [](char c) { return detail::tcl_forbidden_chars.contains(c); }, '_');
2303 this->_tk->createcommand(cbname, std::move(f));
2304 this->_tclCommands.insert(cbname);
2305 return cbname;
2306 }

2313 template<detail::Variable_mode_concept T, detail::createcommand_concept Func>
2314 std::string trace_add(const T& mode, Func&& callback)
2315 {

2317 this->_tk->call("trace", "add", "variable", this->_name, mode, std::vector{ cbname });
2318 return cbname;

2326 void trace_remove(const T& mode, const std::string& cbname)
2327 {
2328 this->_tk->call("trace", "remove", "variable", this->_name, mode, cbname);
2329
2330 for (auto&& [m, ca] : this->trace_info())
2331 if (ca == cbname)
2332 return;
2333
2334 this->_tk->deletecommand(cbname);
2335 this->_tclCommands.erase(cbname);

2340 {

2342 }

2344 template<typename Self, std::derived_from<Variable> Other>
2345 bool operator==(this const Self& self, const Other& other)
2346 {
2347 return self->_name == other._name && self->_tk == other._tk;
2348 }

2539 cnfs::PlaceInfo place_info(this auto&& self)
2540 {
2541 auto str = self.tk->template call<std::string>("place", "info", self._w);
2542 std::vector<std::string> vec = self.tk->splitlist(str);
2543 std::map<std::string, std::string> map(std::from_range, std::views::zip(
2544 vec | /*std::views::*/stride(2),
2545 vec | /*std::views::*/drop(1) | /*std::views::*/stride(2)
2546 ));
2547
2548 auto converter = [&self]<typename T2>(std::string&& v)->T2
2549 {
2550 if constexpr (std::same_as<T2, Misc>)
2551 return self.Misc::nametowidget(std::move(v));
2552 else
2553 return std::move(v);
2554 };
2555
2556 return detail::_splitdict_to_aggregate<cnfs::PlaceInfo>(std::move(map), true, converter);
2557 }
2558 };

2642 class BaseWidget : public Misc
2643 {
2644 protected:
2645 struct impl : Misc::impl
2646 {
2647 std::string widgetName;
2648 std::string _name;
2649
2651 void destroy() override
2652 {
2653 // keeps this from being destroyed before this function returns
2654 auto temp = this->shared_from_this();
2655
2656 for (auto&& child : std::vector(std::from_range, std::views::values(this->children)))
2657 child.destroy();
2658 this->tk->call("destroy", this->_w);
2659 this->master.value().children.erase(this->_name);
2660 this->Misc::impl::destroy();
2661 }
2662 };
2663
2664 public:
2665 REF_TO_IMPL(widgetName);
2666 protected:
2667 REF_TO_IMPL(_name);
2668
2669 IMPL_CTOR(BaseWidget, Misc);
2670 DEFINE_ASSIGNMENT_OPERATOR(BaseWidget)
2671
2672
2675 template<typename Self>
2676 void _setup(this Self&& self, const std::optional<Misc>& master_, auto& cnf, std::set<std::string>& ignore_fields, const std::optional<std::string>& override_name = std::nullopt)
2677 {
2678 auto&& master = master_.has_value() ? master_.value() : detail::_get_default_root();
2679 self.master = master;
2680 self.tk = master.tk;
2681
2682 std::string name{};
2683 if (override_name.has_value())
2684 {
2685 name = override_name.value();
2686 ignore_fields.insert("name");
2687 }
2688 else if constexpr (requires { cnf.name; })
2689 {
2690 utility::invoke_or_and_then([&ignore_fields, &name](auto& v) {
2691 name = v;
2692 ignore_fields.insert("name");
2693 }, cnf.name);
2694 }
2695 if (name.empty())
2696 {
2697 name = hhh::misc::to_lower(reflect::type_name<Self>());
2698
2699 auto count = master._last_child_ids[name] += 1;
2700
2701 if (count == 1)
2702 name = std::format("!{}", name);
2703 else
2704 name = std::format("!{}{}", name, count);
2705 }
2706 self._name = name;
2707 if (master._w == ".")
2708 self._w = "." + name;
2709 else
2710 self._w = master._w + "." + name;
2711
2712 auto&& [it, success] = master.children.emplace(self._name, self);
2713 if (!success)
2714 {
2715 it->second.destroy();
2716 it->second = self;
2717 }
2718 }
2719
2728 template<cnfs::is_cnf CNF>
2729 void _init_(this auto&& self, const std::string& widgetName, CNF&& cnf, std::vector<_cpptkinter::Tcl_Obj>&& extra = {}, std::set<std::string> ignore_fields = {})
2730 {
2731 std::optional<Misc> master{};
2732 if constexpr (requires { cnf.master; })
2733 {
2734 utility::invoke_or_and_then([&master]<typename T>(T && v) {
2735 master = std::forward<T>(v);
2736 }, std::forward<CNF>(cnf).master);
2737 ignore_fields.insert("master");
2738 }
2739
2740 self.widgetName = widgetName;
2741 self._setup(master, cnf, ignore_fields);
2742 self.tk->call(self.widgetName, self._w, std::move(extra), self._options(std::forward<CNF>(cnf), ignore_fields));
2743 DEVIATING_IMPLEMENTATION_WARNING("something with classes in cnf (?)");
2744 }
2745 };

2761 struct Image
2762 {
2763 private:
2764 static inline long long _last_id = 0;
2765 public:
2766 std::string name;
2767 std::shared_ptr<_cpptkinter::TkappObject> tk;
2768
2769 template<typename CNF>
2770 Image(const std::string& imgtype, CNF&& cnf) : tk{ !cnf.master.has_value() ?
2771 detail::_get_default_root("create image").tk :
2772 (std::holds_alternative<Misc>(cnf.master.value()) ?
2773 std::get<Misc>(cnf.master.value()).tk :
2774 std::get<std::shared_ptr<_cpptkinter::TkappObject>>(cnf.master.value())) }
2775 {
2776 const static std::set<std::string> ignore = { "name", "master" };
2777 if (cnf.name.empty())
2778 {
2779 Image::_last_id++;
2780 this->name = std::format("cppimage{}", Image::_last_id);
2781 }
2782
2783 std::vector<_cpptkinter::Tcl_Obj> options{};
2784 auto visitor = [&]<typename T>(T && value, auto I) {
2785 constexpr auto k = reflect::member_name<I, CNF>();
2786
2787 if constexpr (k != "name" && k != "master")
2788 {
2789 options.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-" + std::string(k)));
2790 options.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj(std::forward<T>(value)));
2791 }
2792 };
2793 reflect::for_each<CNF>([&](auto I) { utility::invoke_or_and_then(visitor, reflect::get<I>(std::forward<CNF>(cnf)), I); });
2794
2795 this->tk->call("image", "create", imgtype, this->name, options);
2796 }
2797
2798 ~Image()
2799 {
2800 if (!this->name.empty())
2801 {
2802 this->tk->call("image", "delete", this->name);
2803 }
2804 }
2805
2806 operator std::string() const
2807 {
2808 return this->name;
2809 }
2810
2811 template<detail::AsObjConcept T>
2812 void _setitem_(const std::string& key, T&& value)
2813 {
2814 this->tk->call(this->name, "configure", "-" + key, std::forward<T>(value));
2815 }
2816
2817 template<detail::FromObjConcept R>
2818 R _getitem_(const std::string& key, std::type_identity<R>)
2819 {
2820 return this->tk->call<R>(this->name, "configure", "-" + key);
2821 }
2822
2824 template<typename Self>
2825 detail::set_get_proxy<std::remove_cvref_t<Self>> operator[](this Self&& self, const std::string& key)
2826 {
2827 return { std::forward<Self>(self), key };
2828 }
2829
2831 template<typename Self, cnfs::is_cnf CNF = cnfs::get_constructor_cnf<Self>>
2832 void configure(this Self&& self, CNF&& cnf)
2833 {
2834 std::vector<_cpptkinter::Tcl_Obj> options{};
2835 auto visitor = [&]<typename T>(T && value, auto I) {
2836 constexpr auto k = reflect::member_name<I, CNF>();
2837
2838 if constexpr (k != "name" && k != "master")
2839 {
2840 auto key = std::string(k);
2841 if (key.ends_with('_'))
2842 key.pop_back();
2843 options.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-" + key));
2844 options.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj(std::forward<T>(value)));
2845 }
2846 };
2847 reflect::for_each<CNF>([&](auto I) { utility::invoke_or_and_then(visitor, reflect::get<I>(std::forward<CNF>(cnf)), I); });
2848
2849 self.tk->call(self.name, "config", options);
2850 }
2852 template<typename Self, cnfs::is_cnf CNF = cnfs::get_constructor_cnf<Self>>
2853 void config(this Self&& self, CNF&& cnf)
2854 {
2855 self.configure(std::forward<CNF>(cnf));
2856 }
2857
2859 long long height()
2860 {
2861 return this->tk->call<long long>("image", "height", this->name);
2862 }
2863
2865 std::string type()
2866 {
2867 return this->tk->call<std::string>("image", "type", this->name);
2868 }
2869
2871 long long width()
2872 {
2873 return this->tk->call<long long>("image", "width", this->name);
2874 }
2875 };

3108 auto&& index2 = detail::to_index(index2_);

3110 auto num_index1 = this->index(index1);
3111 auto num_index2 = this->index(index2);
3112
3113 //if (num_index1 is None) or (num_index2 is None) :

3117 {
3118 auto ec = this->entryconfig(i);
3119 if (ec.contains("command"))

3121 auto c = this->entrycget<std::string>(i, "command");
3122 if (!c.empty())

3268 struct Toplevel : BaseWidget, Wm
3269 {
3270 protected:
3271 template<cnfs::is_cnf CNF>
3272 void _init_(const std::string& widgetName, CNF&& cnf)
3273 {
3274 std::vector<_cpptkinter::Tcl_Obj> extra{};
3275 std::set<std::string> ignore_fields{};
3276 reflect::for_each<CNF>([&extra, &ignore_fields, &cnf](auto I) {
3277 constexpr std::string_view wmkey = reflect::member_name<I, CNF>();
3278
3279 if constexpr (wmkey == "screen"
3280 || wmkey == "class_"
3281 || wmkey == "class"
3282 || wmkey == "visual"
3283 || wmkey == "colormap")
3284 {
3285 std::string opt = "-";
3286 if (wmkey.ends_with('_'))
3287 opt += wmkey.substr(0, wmkey.size() - 1);
3288 else
3289 opt += wmkey;
3290
3291
3292 utility::invoke_or_and_then([&extra, &opt]<typename T>(T && v) {
3293 extra.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj(opt));
3294 extra.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj(std::forward<T>(v)));
3295 }, reflect::get<I>(std::forward<CNF>(cnf)));
3296
3297 ignore_fields.insert(std::string(wmkey));
3298 }
3299 });
3300
3301 this->BaseWidget::_init_(widgetName, std::forward<CNF>(cnf), std::move(extra), std::move(ignore_fields));
3302
3303 auto root = this->_root();
3304 this->iconname(root.iconname());
3305 this->title(root.title());
3306 this->protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", std::function<void()>(std::bind_front(&Toplevel::destroy, *this)));
3307 }
3308 public:
3310 CONSTRUCTORS_AND_ASSIGNMENT(Toplevel, cnfs::Toplevel, "toplevel", BaseWidget);
3311 };

3724 struct Checkbutton : Widget

3728 protected:
3729 template<typename Self>
3730 void _setup(this Self& self, const std::optional<Misc>& master_, auto& cnf, std::set<std::string>& ignore_fields)
3731 {
3732 //Because Checkbutton defaults to a variable with the same name as the widget, Checkbutton default names must be globally unique, not just unique within the parent widget.
3733
3734 bool has_name = false;
3735 if constexpr (requires{ cnf.name; })
3736 utility::invoke_or_and_then([&](auto& val) { has_name = !val.empty(); }, cnf.name);
3737
3738 if(!has_name)
3739 {
3740 auto name = hhh::misc::to_lower(reflect::type_name<Self>());
3741 detail::_checkbutton_count += 1;
3742 // To avoid collisions with ttk.Checkbutton, use the different name template.
3743 self.BaseWidget::_setup(master_, cnf, ignore_fields, std::format("!{}-{}", name, detail::_checkbutton_count));
3744 }
3745 else
3746 self.BaseWidget::_setup(master_, cnf, ignore_fields);
3747 }
3748
3749 public:
3751 CONSTRUCTORS_AND_ASSIGNMENT(Checkbutton, cnfs::Checkbutton<long long>, "checkbutton", Widget);

3755 {
3756 this->tk->call(this->_w, "deselect");

4311 std::map<std::string, std::array<std::string, 5>> itemconfigure(detail::index auto&& index)
4312 {
4313 std::string index_{};
4314 if constexpr (std::same_as<std::remove_cvref_t<decltype(detail::to_index(index))>, std::string>)
4315 index_ = detail::to_index(index);
4316 else
4317 index_ = std::to_string(detail::to_index(index));
4318 auto map = this->_configure({ "itemconfigure", index_ });
4319
4320 auto key_view = map | std::views::keys;
4321 auto value_view = map | std::views::values | std::views::transform([](auto& arr) {
4322 std::array<std::string, 5> new_arr{};
4323 std::ranges::move(arr | std::views::transform([](auto& v) { return std::get<std::string>(v); }), new_arr.begin());
4324 return new_arr;
4325 });
4326
4327 return std::views::zip(key_view, value_view) | std::ranges::to<std::map>();
4328 }
4330 template<cnfs::is_cnf CNF = cnfs::Listbox_itemconfigure>
4331 void itemconfigure(detail::index auto&& index, CNF&& cnf = {})
4332 {

4334 if constexpr (std::same_as<std::remove_cvref_t<decltype(index)>, std::string>)
4335 this->_configure({ "itemconfigure", index_ }, std::forward<CNF>(cnf));
4336 else
4337 this->_configure({ "itemconfigure", std::to_string(index_) }, std::forward<CNF>(cnf));
4338 }

4997 template<cnfs::is_cnf CNF = cnfs::Text_dump>
4998 std::vector<std::array<std::string, 3>> dump(CNF&& cnf)
4999 {
5000 DEVIATING_IMPLEMENTATION_WARNING("original also allows passing a callback to receive the vector of arrays, we dont");
5001 std::vector<std::array<std::string, 3>> result{};
5002 std::vector<_cpptkinter::Tcl_Obj> args{};
5003
5004 auto append_triple = [&](std::array<std::string, 3> arr) {
5005 result.emplace_back(std::move(arr));
5006 };
5007 auto func_name = this->_register(std::move(append_triple));
5008 args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-command"));
5009 args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj(func_name));
5010 if (cnf.all) args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-all"));
5011 if (cnf.image) args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-image"));
5012 if (cnf.mark) args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-mark"));
5013 if (cnf.tag) args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-tag"));
5014 if (cnf.text) args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-text"));
5015 if (cnf.window) args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-window"));
5016 args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj(cnf.index1));
5017 if (cnf.index2.has_value())
5018 args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj(cnf.index2.value()));
5019 this->tk->call(this->_w, "dump", args);
5020 return result;
5021 }

5216 // @returns The index of the first character of a match or an empty string.
5217 template<cnfs::is_cnf CNF = cnfs::Text_search>
5218 std::string search(CNF&& cnf)
5219 {
5220 std::vector<_cpptkinter::Tcl_Obj> args{ _cpptkinter::AsObj(this->_w), _cpptkinter::AsObj("search") };
5221 if (cnf.forwards) args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-forwards"));
5222 if (cnf.backwards) args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-backwards"));
5223 if (cnf.exact) args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-exact"));
5224 if (cnf.regexp) args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-regexp"));
5225 if (cnf.nocase) args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-nocase"));
5226 if (cnf.elide) args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-elide"));
5227 if (cnf.count.has_value()) { args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("-count")); _cpptkinter::AsObj(cnf.count.value()); }
5228 if (cnf.pattern.starts_with('-')) args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj("--"));
5229 args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj(cnf.pattern));
5230 args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj(cnf.index));
5231 if (cnf.stopindex.has_value()) args.emplace_back(_cpptkinter::AsObj(cnf.stopindex.value()));
5232 return this->tk->call<std::string>(args);
5233 }

5450 template<typename R>
5451 concept sized_range_of_string = std::ranges::sized_range<R> && std::convertible_to<std::ranges::range_value_t<R>, std::string>;
5452
5454 struct _setit
5455 {
5456 StringVar _var;
5457 std::string _value;
5458 std::function<void(const StringVar&)> _callback;
5459
5460 _setit(StringVar var, std::string value, const std::function<void(const StringVar&)>& callback) : _var(std::move(var)), _value(std::move(value)), _callback(callback)
5461 {
5462
5463 }
5464
5465 void operator()()
5466 {
5467 this->_var.set(this->_value);
5468 if (this->_callback)
5469 this->_callback(this->_var);
5470 }
5471 };
5472 }

5475 class OptionMenu : public Menubutton
5476 {
5477 protected:
5478 struct impl : Menubutton::impl
5479 {
5480 std::optional<Menu> _menu;
5481 std::string menuname;
5482
5484 void destroy() override
5485 {
5486 // keeps this from being destroyed before this function returns
5487 auto temp = this->shared_from_this();
5488
5489 this->_menu.reset();
5490
5491 this->BaseWidget::impl::destroy();
5492 }
5493 };
5494
5495 private:
5496 REF_TO_IMPL(_menu);
5497 public:
5498 REF_TO_IMPL(menuname);
5499
5500 protected:
5501 void _init_(const Misc& master, const StringVar& variable, const detail::sized_range_of_string auto& values, const std::function<void(const StringVar&)>& command)
5502 {
5503 if (values.size() == 0)
5504 throw utility::construct_exception<std::invalid_argument>("values must be non-empty");
5505
5506 this->Menubutton::_init_("menubutton",
5507 cnfs::Menubutton{ .master = master, .anchor = "c", .borderwidth = 2, .highlightthickness = 2, .indicatoron = 1, .relief = constants::RAISED, .textvariable = variable });
5508
5509 this->widgetName = "tk_optionMenu";
5510 auto&& menu = this->_menu.emplace(cnfs::Menu{ .master = *this, .name = "menu", .tearoff = 0 });
5511 this->menuname = menu._w;
5512
5513 for (auto& v : values)
5514 menu.add_command({ .command = detail::_setit(variable, v, command), .label = v });
5515
5516 (*this)["menu"] = menu;
5517 }
5518
5519 IMPL_CTOR(OptionMenu, Menubutton);
5520 public:
5522 OptionMenu(const Misc& master, const StringVar& variable, const detail::sized_range_of_string auto& values, const std::function<void(const StringVar&)>& command = {}) :
5523 OptionMenu(std::make_shared<impl>())
5524 {
5525 this->_init_(master, variable, values, command);
5526 }
5527
5528 DEFINE_ASSIGNMENT_OPERATOR(OptionMenu);

6206cpptkinter::Tk cpptkinter::detail::_get_default_root(const std::string& what)
6207{
6208 if (!_support_default_root)
6209 throw utility::construct_exception<std::runtime_error>("No master specified and tkinter is configured to not support default root");
6210

6212 {
6213 if (!what.empty())
6214 throw utility::construct_exception<std::runtime_error>(std::format("Too early to {}: no default root window", what));
6215 auto root = cpptkinter::Tk();
6216 if (_default_root != root.pimpl)
6217 throw utility::construct_exception<std::runtime_error>("?");
6218 return root;
6219 }
6220 else
6221 return std::shared_ptr(_default_root);
6222}

6240cpptkinter::Misc cpptkinter::Misc::nametowidget(std::string_view name)
6241{
6242 auto index = name.find('.');
6243 std::shared_ptr<impl> w;
6244
6245 if (index == 0)
6246 {
6247 w = this->_root().pimpl;
6248 name.remove_prefix(1);
6249 index = name.find('.');
6250 }
6251 else
6252 w = this->pimpl;
6253
6254 do {
6255 auto current_name = name.substr(0, index);
6256 if (current_name.empty())
6257 break;
6258
6259 w = w->children.at(std::string(current_name)).pimpl;
6260 name.remove_prefix(index + 1);
6261 } while ((index = name.find('.')) != std::string_view::npos);
6262
6263 return w;
6264}

6266cpptkinter::Tk cpptkinter::Misc::_root() const
6267{
6268 std::shared_ptr<impl> w = this->pimpl;
6269
6270 while (w->master.has_value())
6271 w = w->master.value().pimpl;
6272
6273 return std::static_pointer_cast<Tk::impl>(w);
6274}
